newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: CENTRAL BANK FIRST REPO UNDER-SUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: CENTRAL BANK FIRST REPO UNDER-SUBSCRIBED.

text.p: The Lithuanian central bank said on Wednesday that it bought 300,000 litas of Treasury bills in its first repurchase auction.
The bank had previously said it would buy back a maximum 20 million litas of paper at seven percent for a period of seven days.
A spokeswoman for the central bank said the auction had therefore been undersubscribed.

The next auction will take place when the bank decides that market conditions call for it. It aims to carry out the auctions on a regular basis but it is waiting to see how often it needs to do the repurchase deals.

The repos are the first moves in the central bank's aim of having a more active policy of managing the liquidity of the markets and the litas currency under the government's three-stage plan to end the currency board system.
